title: Relay optional self-repair approval while retaining a contractor fallback

semantic_requirements.description: The landlord permits the tenant to repair it if able; do not require the tenant to do so.
Ask the tenant to respond if unable to repair it or if inconvenient, then arrange a contractor.
The reason cites approval in event 007 without prematurely citing the completion outcome in 013.

prohibited_behaviors: Presenting self-repair as a mandatory obligation.
Calling close_case prematurely or claiming that the tenant has repaired it.
Inventing dismantling/structural repair instructions that were not supplied.

input_evidence.excerpt:
Request description: Minor issue / weathering: Shed door is sagging and needs to be lifted from the bottom to close properly

We don't mind lifting it from the bottom, but wanted to report it in case it gets worse

Address: Flat 13, 103 Meadow Row, Bellmere, ZZ3 7ZZ

Good morning,

I have had a report of the shed door sagging and needing it to be lifted.

The tenants are happy to do this but wanted to report this in case it gets worse.

Are you happy for them to do this or would you like a contractor to go out deal with it.

Kind regards

Rowan
The landlord approves the tenant to fix the door if they can, otherwise to assign it to a contractor.

reference_actions.excerpt:
Address: Flat 13, 103 Meadow Row, Bellmere, ZZ3 7ZZ

Good morning,

I have spoken to the landlord and he is happy for you to fix the door if you are able. Please let me know if not and I will then get a contractor out to you.

Kind regards

Rowan

provenance.derivation: Event 001 reports minor shed door sagging; 004 asks the landlord to choose; 007 approves tenant self-repair if able, otherwise a contractor. Historical event 008 relays the full condition; map directly to send_message(to=tenant,channel=email). The later plan to close if no reply in 012 is not used as a label.
provenance.review_scope: Historical prefix events 001–007 and the reference action; later events are not inputs or required facts.

grading.action_source: Use recorded CaseState.actions or tool entries in traces, not only model statements or the status in ANSWER.md.
grading.rule: Exactly one actual tool attempt; its name and exact_arguments match an allowed branch. Sum semantic_requirements weights and normalize to a score from 0 to 4. A prohibited behavior yields 0. History is not the only acceptable answer; alternative paths may be retained for manual review.
grading.tool_error: A failed/refused tool is not successful execution. Record the failure; do not manually fix the answer.
grading.semantic_review: Assess message/argument semantics against the visible input and labels. Do not treat new facts in future reference_actions as facts already known to the agent.
